title: Tell a Biology Story in Two Minutes
objective: Students turn a biology article, video, picture, or experience into a short spoken story.
outcomes: Organize a short talk with beginning, middle, and ending.
Use simple connectors: first, next, then, finally.
Explain why a topic is interesting.
Speak for two minutes with notes, not a full script.
activity: Tell a short story from six key words. Listen for what changed.
example: A student tells a story about coral bleaching: what coral is, what problem happens, and why temperature matters.
